summary: Arms with Spearing Strike and Improved Bloodrage against a Giant or Dragonkin boss such as Onyxia; 3.4% ahead of the generic Arms build on its own boss at 180 s.
advantage: Spearing Strike does 80% more damage to Giants and Dragonkin. Against such a boss the talent is worth taking, so this build puts it in the rotation. The normal Arms build spends those points elsewhere.
rotation: With 20 sec left, Recklessness ready and under 25 Rage: swap to Berserker Stance and stay
Death Wish held for the last 36 sec, Recklessness in the last 20 sec; racials with Death Wish
Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec; Bloodrage under 10 Rage
Slam from 20 Rage (15 sec cooldown with Improved Slam), outside execute
Rend kept up outside execute; then Execute
Heroic Strike from 70 Rage, Hamstring filler from 20 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: Spearing Strike only works against Giants and Dragonkin

Rage from white hits is normalised to the weapon: k × swing speed (k 3.46 one-hand, 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30), growing with level to ×1.5 at 60 (s = 0.5), the off hand the same. An assumption until measured at 60
Fury has no Dragonkin build: a stance dance for Spearing Strike is worth only +0.4% (dual wield) and +0.8% (two-hand)

Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client attribute); Deep Wounds tick timer restarting on each crit is a modelling choice
Crit Rage bonus assumed white hits only; Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath (open assumptions)
One +2% crit elixir a character: whether Ferocity stacks with Mongoose in game is open; a second crit elixir (Grizzly) would add 10.9
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted (would add 8.4 at Undead 180 s)
Booming Voice (5/5) does nothing because the raid has Battle Shout
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as warrior__arms except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeDragonkin, as the class preset's encounter does.
